current_auth_caps_reference.note: reference only; feasibility is computed against a live AuthSnapshot at verify time

created_for: LEVEL3-PILOT-R4 execution protocol (zero real model calls at freeze time)

development.selection_rule: first 20 official train indices (frozen before calls; not performance-based)

generation_tasks.note: R4 mutations are syntactic MutationPlan operators; no LLM rewrite generation set

endpoints.holm_note: F1 Holm(5) is TASK-level only. Seed-level RQ3 family F2 = {E-D, E-C} uses IUT (both must reject favoring E). No Holm(2) on F2. R>=6 is necessary not sufficient (n_eff).
endpoints.primary: co-primary seed-level paired E-D and E-C confirmation accuracy (IUT; conditional on frozen 40 tasks)

rq3_comparisons.claim_rule: IUT: joint claim E beats BOTH D and C requires BOTH E-D and E-C to reject in favor of E at alpha=0.05; no Holm(2) on F2. Single-comparison confirmatory claims need separate pre-declared FWER control else exploratory only.

tests.seed_level: exact Wilcoxon signed-rank two-sided on paired d[r]

evaluation.answer_extract: project extractor; exact match on canonical gold

instruction_pool: Solve step by step, end with 'Answer: <num>'.
Think carefully, verify arithmetic, final number after 'Answer:'.
Compute directly. Output the numeric answer after 'Answer:'.

operator_policy.failure_mode: FailedCandidate retained at slot with dev_accuracy=0; never silent redraw

pairing_blocks.description: D and E share MutationPlan seed in block r; slots 0-1 from Parent; E slots 2-3 from gen-1 winner

selection_rules.d_final: max dev accuracy among 4 slots; ties -> creation order
selection_rules.e_final: max dev accuracy among 4 slots; ties -> creation order e1a<e1b<e2a<e2b
selection_rules.gen1_winner: max dev accuracy on shared dev set; ties -> creation order
